name: TC-441: pacing-guard UX — with no capped periods, toggling online booking ON renders the server's error inline and booking stays OFF
description: PUT .../reservation-settings refuses onlineBookingEnabled:true (400 RESERVATION_PACING_REQUIRED) until at least one active service period has a pacing cap — this fresh tenant has zero periods. The resolved English message renders inline next to the toggle with a "Go to Service periods" link; the server value stays false.
